claims.quote: Admins and users don't need to take any action to set up Copilot Search. If a user has an eligible Microsoft Copilot license, Copilot Search appears as a tab in the Microsoft Copilot app.

claims.claim: Copilot surfaces only organisational data the user already has at least view permission to access, including the searchable meeting content.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot only surfaces organizational data to which individual users have at least view permissions.

claims.claim: The feature operates within the current user's identity-based data-access boundary.
claims.quote: Semantic Index honors the user identity-based access boundary so that the grounding process only accesses content that the current user is authorized to access.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Teams Transcription policy governs whether transcripts can be created, providing the transcript prerequisite for transcript-text matches.
claims.quote: For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not describe the transcription policy as a control over searching existing transcripts.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot find meetings topics keywords 559110 admin disable meeting search policySettings Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy. Read meeting-transcription-captions and release notes; the policy permits transcription, with no restriction on search of existing files described.

claims.claim: Transcription is a per-organiser policy setting.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting.

claims.claim: Transcription is a per-user policy setting.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting.

claims.claim: Transcription is on by default for new meeting policies.
claims.quote: Toggle Transcription On or Off. This setting is On by default for new policies.

claims.claim: Meeting transcription is controlled in Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription $false changes the selected meeting policy to prevent transcription.
claims.quote:
To manage meeting transcription using PowerShell, use the -AllowTranscription parameter in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy.
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: Licence assignment is available in Microsoft 365 admin center > Billing > Licenses > product > Assign licenses.
claims.quote:
In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page.
Select a product.
On the product details page, select Assign licenses.

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns the specified licence to a user.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Assigning a Microsoft Copilot licence governs access to the licensed product, not just this individual search enhancement.
claims.quote: The following plans are eligible prerequisite licenses for Microsoft Copilot. After you purchase licenses, assign the licenses to users in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
